name: FM/operator-stack uplifter with long pitch envelope and synced noise swell
goal: Build a dense FM uplifter: stack multiple operators (low formant carrier, self-feedback raspy modulators, bright triangles/squares into the output, chord-ish ratios distorting a mid operator), mono with light voice pan, bit of digital crush, opposing looped envelopes (slow reverse swell vs stabby), a tempo-synced pitch envelope rising over ~8 bars, and a noise operator whose amp/FM depth shares that same rising envelope, finished with EQ and reverb.

source.title: FM8 - FX Sounds - pt 1 - Uplifter - How To Tutorial

prerequisites: FM synth or operator stack with ratios, feedback, shared pitch envelope, noise op

inputs.name: rise_bars
inputs.description: Length of the pitch rise (transcript ~8 bars / pitch env ~31–32/4)

outputs.name: fm_uplifter
outputs.description: Layered FM uplifter with noise intensity swell

constraints: Portable signal-flow recipe for Web Audio / Traveler-inspired / any hybrid synth with comparable modules; not affiliated with any vendor.
Do not copy proprietary factory preset banks, wavetable file names, or sample packs; use original/free waves or generic shapes.
Steps and numeric values are grounded only in the YouTube Show-transcript text; approximate where the speaker gestured without stating a number.
Map FM8 operator letters to generic carriers/modulators; ratios and feedback amounts are the portable content, not the product UI.
Numeric depths (e.g. feedback 32, env amount ~54) are as spoken; tweak to taste on another FM engine.

steps.action: Carrier/low layer: one operator to output at full level, ratio ~0.25, formant-ish wave (transcript: 3rd formant) for a low body.
Add a raspy modulator into that carrier (~28 depth) with self-feedback on both (~5 on the mod, ~32 on the carrier); set mod ratio ~0.5 with a higher formant wave (transcript: 8th formant).
Bright layers to output: triangle at ratio 4 and a square-ish (1+3+5) at ratio 1, each ~88 level, with some self-feedback on the triangle (~16).
steps.expect: High metallic edge above the bed

steps.action: Distort a mid operator with two further ops (triangle at ratio ~1.25 into it ~54; saw-ish 1+2+3 at ratio 0.25 into that modulator) for a slight chord/cluster rasp.
steps.expect: Inharmonic/chordy grit on the mid layer

steps.action: Master: monophonic, 2 voices, detune off, light pan (~25–26%) between voices; add mild bit-crush/digital (~65) for FX character.
steps.expect: Stable mono-ish FX with light width and digital edge

steps.action: Envelopes: tempo-sync; give some operators a slow reverse/fade-in looped sustain shape (e.g. over 3/16) and others a stabby attack with sustain loop so layers move against each other.
steps.expect: Animated stacked contour without a single static pad

steps.action: Pitch envelope: tempo-sync a long rising sustain envelope across ~8 bars (~31–32/4), amount ~54, slightly curved for a smoother bend; hold MIDI at a sustained note (e.g. C3).

Noise operator to output (~58) with amp up, bright cutoff, mild resonance (~55–57); FM-noise into several tonal ops (e.g. ~50/30/16). Save/load the same rising pitch envelope onto the noise amp so noise and its FM distortion swell with the rise. EQ low-mids/highs; reverb ~33–34% wet.
steps.expect: Intensity climbs with pitch; space from reverb without washing the rise

verification: Over the rise_bars window pitch climbs and noise contribution increases together
Tonal stack remains recognizable if noise is muted
Mono voice mode prevents uncontrolled poly detune during the glide
